Kashmir receives first snowfall of the season

The higher reaches of Kashmir, including the Zojila and Sonamarg areas, received the first snowfall of the season. This snowfall has led to a drop in temperatures in the higher altitude regions. Some reports also mentioned hailstorms in plains areas.
